phac_presidents.name: Tina Namiesniowski
phac_presidents.role: President, Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC)
phac_presidents.notable: PHAC President when NML scientists Drs. Xiangguo Qiu and Keding Cheng were escorted out July 5 2019. Resigned September 2020 mid-COVID/NML period - departure publicly attributed to pandemic strain but coincident with Qiu file escalation.

phac_presidents.name: Iain Stewart
phac_presidents.role: President, Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC)
phac_presidents.notable: PHAC President admonished by Speaker Anthony Rota at the bar of the Commons June 21 2021 for refusing to produce unredacted NML documents - first such admonishment in 108 years. Reassigned to Treasury Board Sept 2021. Symbol of crown-vs-parliament showdown.

phac_presidents.name: Heather Jeffrey
phac_presidents.role: President, Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC)
phac_presidents.notable: PHAC President in office when redacted documents released June 28 2024 under all-party Speaker order. Inherited the disposition of the Qiu/Cheng dismissal records and the post-CSIS-clearance review structure.

health_canada_deputy_ministers.name: Stephen Lucas
health_canada_deputy_ministers.notable: DM Health throughout NML scandal escalation. Presided over the inter-agency response to the contempt-of-parliament finding and the 2021 Federal Court application by Speaker Rota seeking the documents - withdrawn after 2021 election prorogation.

health_canada_deputy_ministers.name: Heather Jeffrey
health_canada_deputy_ministers.role: Deputy Minister of Health (concurrent PHAC role)
health_canada_deputy_ministers.notable: Listed cross-role as DM Health-equivalent through PHAC presidency. Document release authority June 2024 sat with this office.

public_safety_ministers.name: Bill Blair
public_safety_ministers.notable: Public Safety Minister at time of July 5 2019 escort-out and the Jan 2021 dismissals. CSIS reported under his portfolio during the active-investigation phase. Refused to confirm or deny security review on the record.

public_safety_ministers.name: Marco Mendicino
public_safety_ministers.notable: Minister during Liberal refusal to comply with OGGO + Canada-China Committee orders, Federal Court motion, and the 2022 NSICOP referral. Already Grover-marked in foreign-interference and CSIS-oversight axes.

public_safety_ministers.name: Dominic LeBlanc
public_safety_ministers.notable: Minister when files released June 28 2024 under all-party Speaker order via NSICOP-cleared review process. Negotiated the redaction protocol. Already Grover-marked in foreign, carney, csis_oversight axes.

csis_directors.name: David Vigneault
csis_directors.notable: CSIS Director throughout the entire NML investigation. Conducted the security review that resulted in the Qiu/Cheng dismissals. Documents released June 2024 confirm CSIS assessed Qiu had been engaged in an undisclosed relationship with Wuhan Institute of Virology + PRC Thousand Talents Plan. Already Grover-marked in CSIS oversight axis.

nsicop_chairs.name: David McGuinty
nsicop_chairs.role: Chair, National Security and Intelligence Committee of Parliamentarians
nsicop_chairs.notable: NSICOP Chair throughout. Body that ultimately became the document-clearance vehicle in the all-party 2024 protocol. Sajjan-mode review committee handled the cleared summary.

nsicop_chairs.name: John McKay
nsicop_chairs.role: Vice-Chair / interim NSICOP review structures (post-2024 transition)
nsicop_chairs.notable: Senior Liberal MP active on Public Safety + National Defence committees during NML release transition. Surfaced during the June 2024 cleared-review protocol negotiations. Sits on intersecting oversight bodies covering NML follow-up.

speakers_of_house.name: Anthony Rota
speakers_of_house.role: Speaker of the House of Commons
speakers_of_house.notable: Speaker who admonished PHAC President Stewart at the bar of the Commons June 21 2021 - first since 1913. Issued the production order. Filed Federal Court application Speaker of the House v Attorney General 2021 - withdrawn after 2021 election. Resigned Sept 26 2023 over unrelated Yaroslav Hunka incident.

speakers_of_house.name: Greg Fergus
speakers_of_house.role: Speaker of the House of Commons
speakers_of_house.notable: Speaker who oversaw the all-party agreement on document release protocol - cleared review by ad-hoc panel of MPs with security clearances. Files released June 28 2024 under his speakership.

prime_ministers_of_record.name: Justin Trudeau
prime_ministers_of_record.notable: PM during entire arc July 2019 escort-out through June 2024 release. Government refused four parliamentary production orders (March 31 2021, May 10 2021, June 2 2021, June 16 2021), withdrew the Federal Court action only on prorogation, and lost the contempt vote 179-149 June 17 2021. Already Grover-marked in 7 axes.

prime_ministers_of_record.name: Mark Carney
prime_ministers_of_record.notable: PM custodian of post-release review and any consequential actions on related programs. NSIRA + NSICOP follow-up reviews continue under his government.

individual_subjects.name: Dr. Xiangguo Qiu
individual_subjects.role: Head, Vaccine Development and Antiviral Therapies, NML Special Pathogens
individual_subjects.notable: Co-developer of ZMapp (Ebola). Dismissed Jan 2021 after CSIS review. Documents released June 2024 disclose undisclosed engagements with Wuhan Institute of Virology, PRC Thousand Talents Plan participation, and pre-approved transfer of Ebola/Henipavirus samples to WIV March 2019. Subject of investigation - listed as accountability subject not decision-maker.

timeline.event: Pre-approved transfer of Ebola/Henipavirus samples from NML to Wuhan Institute of Virology.
Drs. Xiangguo Qiu, Keding Cheng, and students escorted out of NML by RCMP. PHAC says administrative.
PHAC formally terminates Drs. Qiu and Cheng (announced May 9 2021).
Canada-China Committee orders production of unredacted documents. Refused.
OGGO + CACN reissue production order. Refused.
House of Commons orders production. Refused.
House finds PHAC President Iain Stewart in contempt 179-149.
Speaker Rota admonishes Stewart at the bar of the Commons - first since 1913.
Speaker of the House v Attorney General Federal Court application filed.
Trudeau prorogues Parliament for 2021 election; Federal Court action withdrawn.
NSICOP requested to review NML matter under cleared procedure.
All-party agreement on ad-hoc panel of cleared MPs to review unredacted documents.
Redacted NML documents released publicly. Confirm Qiu engaged with WIV + Thousand Talents Plan undisclosed.
Cleared MP panel completes initial review; recommends NSIRA + NSICOP follow-up.
RCMP confirms continuing investigation but no criminal charges laid as of 2024.
No criminal charges. No deportation. No biosecurity legislation enacted. Carney government inherits review.

statutory_framework: Public Health Agency of Canada Act - S.C. 2006, c. 5
Canadian Security Intelligence Service Act - R.S.C. 1985, c. C-23
Security of Information Act - R.S.C. 1985, c. O-5 (foreign-influenced threats)
House of Commons production powers (s. 18 Constitution Act 1867 + Bourinot/Marleau-Montpetit)
National Security and Intelligence Committee of Parliamentarians Act - S.C. 2017, c. 15
Human Pathogens and Toxins Act - S.C. 2009, c. 24
commissions_and_inquiries: Standing Committee on Canada-China Relations (CACN) NML hearings 2021
Standing Committee on Government Operations and Estimates (OGGO) NML hearings 2021
Special ad-hoc panel of cleared MPs 2024 (Speaker Fergus protocol)
litigation_and_motions: Speaker of the House v Attorney General of Canada (Federal Court 2021) - withdrawn
Bar-of-Commons admonishment of PHAC President June 21 2021 - first in 108 years
implementation_tracking: CSIS Foreign Research Security Guidelines updated 2021 + 2023
Tri-Council Policy Statement on research security
NSIRA reviews of CSIS handling of NML investigation
accountability_chain.result_2025: Documents released June 28 2024 confirm Drs. Qiu and Cheng engaged in undisclosed relationships with Wuhan Institute of Virology and Thousand Talents Plan. Pre-approved Ebola/Henipavirus transfer to WIV occurred March 2019. No criminal charges laid as of Dec 2025. No deportation proceedings. No comprehensive biosecurity legislation enacted. PHAC President Stewart admonished at bar - reassigned to Treasury Board, no resignation. Government refused 4 parliamentary production orders, lost contempt vote, withdrew its own Federal Court action only on prorogation. CSIS review process produced dismissal but no prosecution. Five-year delay between escort-out (July 2019) and document release (June 2024).
